status: proposal (claude-a/progression, 25 Oct); every number is a placeholder until play-tests and Claude L's harness
name: Iona
identity: grassland storm-lancer; one 92 px spear in the RIGHT hand, the LEFT grips the same shaft for two-handed actions; long braid down the back, magenta scarf
home_region_note: Claude K's proposal on #149 (25 Oct), not yet decided by Matt; it only sets the tier material

abilities.kit: game/data/abilities/iona.json (Codex, #261); base and powered form unchanged

techniques.name: Gale Step
techniques.binding: primary within 0.3 s after a dodge
techniques.effect: The roll flows into a long thrust that reaches further than Spearpoint.

upgrade.name: Gale Step II
upgrade.effect: A Gale Step that hits gives back half a dodge charge.

techniques.name: Static Charge
techniques.binding: passive: every third spear hit on the same foe charges it
techniques.effect: The next Wind lunge into a charged foe discharges one small arc to a second foe. Smaller than Storm Mantle's arcs, and only from a lunge.

fx: charge mark on the foe (2 drawings)

upgrade.name: Static Charge II
upgrade.effect: The discharge interrupts a shooter's wind-up, once per foe.

techniques.name: Windbreak
techniques.binding: raise Gust guard within 0.2 s of a projectile reaching you
techniques.effect: The projectile is turned back along its path instead of draining guard.

upgrade.name: Windbreak II
upgrade.effect: Deflected projectiles carry a storm arc.
